text: Nothing in the latest data suggests a downturn is starting. The Sahm Rule, the U-6 Modified Sahm Rule and the Michez Rule all read zero, and only construction and information are still showing signs of weakness. Recently, the share of indicators signaling a recession peaked in November 2024, when 27 of 57 were signaling. The longest-running alarms were among teenagers, young adults, the poorest families and Black workers, and in mining, agriculture, information and hospitality.
